body.x: Posco Energy(www.poscoenergy.com) will be introducing its operation of new and renewable energy power plant and fuel cell at Korea Energy Show 2016, which will run Nov. 8-11 at KINTEX.

Posco Energy is a part of Posco, and it is in charge of power plant, fuel cells, and new and renewable energy businesses. In the show, it is going to demonstrate its four core energy businesses which consist of power generation, new and renewable energy, fuel cells, and resource development. It will also show the operation of new and renewable power plant by natural gas, solar power, wind power, and resource circulation.
It will also introduce its 100MW fuel cell production district building plan, fuel cell usage in Korea, and energy products for buildings, ships, and emergency situations.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by Korea Energy Agency, Korea Energy Show 2016 is a comprehensive trade show covering new energy business, new and renewable energy, high-efficiency energy, energy environment, and energy policy technology. It was prepared to provide marketing support to the energy companies to contribute to the development and stimulation of the energy industry of Korea.
